title: Cellular mechanisms of serotonergic psychedelics - apical hypercontextualisation
title_zh: 5-HT2A受体介导致幻剂的细胞机制——顶树突高语境化
abstract: Classical serotonergic psychedelics primarily exert their profound effects through agonism at the serotonin 2A (5-HT2A) receptor, which is abundantly expressed in many cortical regions, particularly in layer V pyramidal neurons of associative and visual areas. At the cellular level, these receptors are predominantly localized postsynaptically on the soma and apical dendrites. This review synthesizes evidence from distinct subfields of psychedelic cognitive neuroscience to illuminate how 5-HT2A agonism at apical dendrites of layer V pyramidal neurons disrupts the usual boundaries of conscious mental representations, boosting their interaction with surrounding contextual influences. We propose "apical hypercontextualisation" as a unifying hypothesis, whereby enhanced apical signaling amplifies relational processing over direct stimulus representation. Finally, we overview key psychedelic phenomenological features - such as perceptual distortions, associative cognition, and self-alterations - demonstrating how they emerge from contextual amplification, with implications for therapeutic mechanisms in mental health disorders.
abstract_zh: 经典的5-羟色胺致幻剂主要通过激动5-羟色胺2A受体（5-HT2A）发挥其深远作用，该受体在许多皮层区域中高表达，尤其富集于关联区和视觉区的第Ⅴ层锥体神经元。细胞水平上，这些受体主要定位于胞体及其顶树突上的突触后部位。本文综述整合了致幻剂认知神经科学不同分支的证据，阐明了在第Ⅴ层锥体神经元顶树突上的5-HT2A激动如何扰乱意识表征的常规边界，并增强其与周围语境因素的相互作用。我们提出“顶树突高语境化”作为统一假说，即顶树突信号增强将关系性加工放大于直接刺激表征。最后，我们概述了致幻体验的关键现象特征，如知觉扭曲、联想性认知以及自我改变，并说明这些现象如何由语境放大机制产生，从而对精神障碍治疗机制具有启示意义。
